en: So AI agents are in the end pieces of
software that use a large language model as
brain.
Those AI agents internally run so-called
agent loops. And I already briefly described
that agent loop in other lectures.
The idea is simple. You as the user of that
piece of software send a prompt to it.
Now behind the scenes, that prompt is then
combined with other instructions, other
relevant pieces of information by the
agentic software, by the ChatGPT
application, for example.
Those extra instructions may include a
system prompt set up by the creators of the
software, so by OpenAI, for example. It may
also typically include tool
descriptions, so descriptions of the tools
the large language model may decide to use.
Because I described before that the large
language model doesn't use tools, instead it
requests tool calls.
So the agent loop is all about receiving
your input, enriching that with extra
instructions, sending that to the large
language model. Then the large language
model replicates a thought process by
emitting tokens. And then that model may
make the decision that it wants to use a
tool. So it would then send back that tool
call request to the surrounding piece of
software, to the AI agent software.
That AI agent software takes a look at what
it got back from the model. And if it is a
requested tool call, it will run the
relevant code, make that tool call, and then
send back the result of that tool call to
the large language model. And then that loop
continues. That's the agent loop. So that
the large language model is queried over and
over again, always getting the full
conversation and all the past tool results
until it comes to the conclusion that it has
done everything it was asked to do.
To do or that it has all the information it
needs to generate a final answer.
And once it then returns that final answer
instead of a tool call request, the agent
loop is done and the AI agent software will
exit out of that loop and present that final
answer to the user.
That's how AI agents work in a nutshell. No
matter if you're building such an AI agent
yourself or if you're using a tool like
Claude or the ChatGPT application,
internally they're running this agent loop.
